login.error.qobuzUnavailable: Could not prepare the sign-in from the web player. Try again later, or use token sign-in. Details are in the server logs.
login.error.tokenRejected: Qobuz rejected this token: it is invalid, expired, or was issued for another Qobuz application — the response does not tell which. Use “Sign in with Qobuz”, copy a new token from play.qobuz.com, or enter the App ID and App Secret of the application that issued it under “Custom App ID / Secret”.
login.error.network: Cannot reach the Qobuz servers. Check your connection.
qobuzSignIn.title: Qobuz sign-in
qobuzSignIn.connected: Qobuz account connected. You can go back to the app.
qobuzSignIn.connectedAs: Qobuz account connected: {0}. You can go back to the app.
qobuzSignIn.error.state: This sign-in link is no longer valid: it expired, was already used or did not come from this server. Start “Sign in with Qobuz” again from QBDL.
qobuzSignIn.error.notAdmin: Only an administrator can connect the Qobuz account. Start the sign-in again from an administrator account.
qobuzSignIn.error.refused: Qobuz did not confirm the sign-in. Start “Sign in with Qobuz” again from QBDL; details are in the server logs.
qobuzSignIn.error.network: Cannot reach the Qobuz servers. Check the server's connection, then start “Sign in with Qobuz” again from QBDL.
qobuzSignIn.error.appCredentials: Qobuz account recognized, but the app credentials could not be retrieved from the Qobuz web player. Try again later; details are in the server logs.
